newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Merc names Kilcollin president, chief exec.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Merc names Kilcollin president, chief exec.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange said Thursday it named Eric Kilcollin president and chief executive officer, replacing William Brodsky.
Kilcollin, currently executive vice president of business development, will assume the post in February, the exchange said.
Brodsky said earlier this month he had accepted the job of chief executive officer at the Chicago Board Options Exchange.
The CME also named Gerald Beyer chief operating officer. Beyer is currently executive vice president and chief administrative officer.

"Rick and Jerry represent continuity in the management of the exchange," chairman Jack Sandner said in a statement. "Their knowledge and ability to keep moving forward our many initiatives are key assets to the Merc at this time." ((-Derivatives desk,3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
